panels.description: In the colder control chamber beyond the sealed shutter, Alex and fully unfolded Bi11bot stand among damp rock, rusted rails, and old manual pipes. The same awakened white-and-amber node remains behind the shutter grille. Alex holds Adrian’s opened steel watch against the node’s matching equation; the marks align visually but nothing opens. Bi11bot faces the dark tunnel with soft amber eyes. Leave upper-left for TIK… and upper-right for one balloon only.

The opened watch is held against the original node’s matching looping pattern. A small edge status indicator reads UNAUTHORIZED MANUAL INTERVENTION in an isolated lower-left display zone. Keep the equation unobstructed; reserve upper-right for Alex’s first balloon and bottom-right for Bi11bot’s reply.

A distant mechanical work-light sweeps once across the far tunnel wall without revealing its carrier. Bi11bot’s right eye ring clicks toward the sound. Keep KLANG… KLANG… KLANG… in a dedicated far-left tunnel zone, physically attached to the approaching sound and clear of the upper-right balloon.

Alex closes his fingers around the open watch but keeps it pressed against the matching equation. He turns from the sealed shutter toward the deeper tunnel, placing himself between Bi11bot and the approaching light. Keep the vanishing point ahead; place the final KLANG in the far-left tunnel zone and reserve upper-right for Alex’s final balloon.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: We find out what he was investigating.
